answer: Sybil resistance requires binding each agent identity to a remotely verified enclave report: MRENCLAVE commits to approved code, while a hardware-rooted attestation key proves the report came from genuine silicon. Copying a VM or software image cannot copy that key or produce another valid platform attestation, so additional accepted identities require acquiring and provisioning physical hardware rather than duplicating virtual machines. A nebula, gale, or tide of clones cannot erase this cost.
